subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard add a durable `ready_to_merge` status and fail-closed completion review gate as the permanent lifecycle contract?
rationale: The PR is not only a bug repair: it adds a model-facing tool, a stored status, and stricter completion behavior that can affect existing Workboard users and upgrades, so the permanent lifecycle shape needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Repair and keep the new lifecycle
options.body: Preserve the existing response envelope, require passed review proof for every completion, declare the tool/status everywhere, update consumers/tests, and require real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Avoid the new stored status
options.body: Redesign the review gate using existing statuses if maintainers do not want `ready_to_merge` as durable Workboard state.

options.title: Accept fail-closed behavior with proof
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept runtime failures for unreviewed completion, but should require explicit upgrade proof and docs for existing Workboard flows.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep the new lifecycle
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing response envelope, require passed review proof for every completion, declare the tool/status everywhere, update consumers/tests, and require real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the clearest current-main routing candidate from blame on the Workboard tool/status surfaces and was already pulled into this PR timeline.
